## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes locally
- [ ] Tests cover the change
- [ ] A changeset is included (`pnpm changeset`) if a published package changes for users
- [ ] READMEs, the skill or `docs/decisions.md` are updated where behavior or the public API changed
- [ ] No real merchant keys, webhook secrets or customer data anywhere in the diff
- [ ] Docs are in my own words; nothing is copied from Bonum's documentation
